body:
Adds `research/beam-twin`: approach speed certified by a lidar twin with independent beam dropout vs a real sensor whose scans fade together. Exact scan-product miss law checked against a beam-pattern Monte Carlo; fade floor s^n; sign reversal when several returns are needed; repair by measured fade rate. Stylised, simulated "real" sensor, no field data.

Updates README bullet and site/projects.json; `python site/build.py` prints ok. 9 unit tests pass.
